description.en: The weather where you are, as on your iPhone and Mac: the temperature, the sky and today's high and low at a glance. Medium adds the next six hours, large the week ahead. It finds your town on its own, or shows a place you type.

scopes.net:api.open-meteo.com: Read the forecast for your place from Open-Meteo (no account).
scopes.net:geocoding-api.open-meteo.com: Find a place you type on the map (Open-Meteo, no account).
scopes.net:get.geojs.io: Guess your town from your internet address, so the weather shows with no setup (GeoJS, no account). Type a place in Settings to stop this.

place.title: Place
place.description: A city or town, for example Lisbon or Austin, Texas. Leave it empty to use where you are.

look.title: Background
look.description: sky: the sky's color, as in Apple's Weather. plain: your theme's background.
